0022600138.text: The Houston Rockets (4-0, 1st in the Southwest and 2nd in the West) are on a four-game winning streak and 2-0 on the road as they visit the Milwaukee Bucks (1-3, 12th in the East and 2.5 games back in the Central). Steven Adams is out with a calf strain, and Marcus Smart is day-to-day with a forearm strain and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Houston won both meetings in 2025-26, including a 119-113 win in Houston on April 1, 2026.
